### File Structure
*~52,264 tokens/session saved*
Feature code lives under `lib/features/<feature>/presentation/{screens,widgets}/` — NOT `lib/features/<feature>/{screens,widgets}/`. Examples: `products/presentation/widgets/batch_stock_update_sheet.dart`, `expenses/presentation/screens/expenses_screen.dart`, `settings/presentation/staff_screen.dart`. Always include the `presentation/` segment; guessing the shorter path causes repeated file_not_found → `find` cycles.

### Key Paths
*~11,343 tokens/session saved*
Reusable UI conventions: bottom-sheet wrapper `lib/shared/widgets/app_bottom_sheet.dart`; responsive modal helper `lib/core/utils/responsive_modal.dart` (`showResponsiveModal`); reference sheet `lib/features/settings/presentation/update_prompt.dart`. Read these three first when converting/auditing sheets.

### Supabase
*~6,000 tokens/session saved*
Live project id is `kfqionlpnjetpmuzsvfb` — use it directly instead of calling `list_projects`. Never call `list_tables` with `verbose=true` across all schemas: output (~67K chars) exceeds the token limit and gets truncated. Query `information_schema.columns` for the specific table instead. ### Commands
*~3,500 tokens/session saved*
For single-file lint use `dart analyze <file>` — `flutter analyze` re-resolves/downloads packages each run and has timed out at 2m. `sleep N` is blocked by the harness; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition. A stray `rtk` prefix (`command not found: rtk`) appeared when chaining `sed -i ''`/echo commands — verify the command string before running.
